changelog:
- YouTube Black Screen Glitch Fix: Removed ytInitialData property hook which was breaking YouTube page render cycle causing 5-10s black flash. Only ytInitialPlayerResponse is now hooked for ad stripping.
- YouTube Safe Resource Guard: Added explicit guard preventing misblocking of YouTube player infrastructure (googlevideo.com, ytimg.com, gstatic.com) even when ad patterns partially match URL strings.
- CSS Scope Fix: Generic ad class selectors (.ad-container, .ad-banner) no longer match YouTube player container elements.
- scrubNewsAds: Now skips youtube.com completely to prevent accidental player container removal.
- Precision Ad Skip: playbackRate 16x and ended event now only fire on short/blocked ad streams, never on regular content videos.
